translations.web: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
translations.bsb: “What have you done?” replied the LORD. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
translations.kjv: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
